quests.title: Custom Gift Envelope No. 3

dialogue.t: Fancy seeing you in these parts, {NICKNAME}. You must be here for Lantern Rite, too!

dialogue.sit: Are you making a gift envelope?

dialogue.t: Yeah, I'm trying make one for Candace, but I'm not happy with the result so far. I was just about to start from scratch.

dialogue.sit: Did Candace not come with you?

dialogue.t: Not yet, but she'll be here.
She didn't agree to come with me to Liyue at first. Said she had to stay behind to protect the village.
I told her everyone deserves to let loose at the end of the year. I had to escort a caravan to Liyue, anyway, so she might as well come along.
I even offered for some of my guys to look after the village in the meantime.
But, I couldn't convince her. In the end, she only changed her mind because the people in the village pestered her to take time off.
Even then, she still insisted on wrapping up some work first.
But, the caravan waits for no one... So, I'm here on my own for now.
It was so hard to pick out a gift — there are just too many nice things to choose from around here!
I ended up getting her a necklace, but then I heard about the whole gift envelope tradition during Lantern Rite, so I decided to try making one.
And, well... Like I said, it hasn't been going great.
I'm sure you know more about this than me, {NICKNAME}. Can you give me some tips?

dialogue.sit: No problem, let me take a look...

dialogue.t: I'm sure you know more about this than me, {NICKNAME}. Can you give me some tips?

dialogue.sit: No problem, let me take a look...

dialogue.t: Ooh? Looks like you've got a real knack for crafts. This gift envelope is beautiful, thank you!
I guess this is like your gift to me! I don't have anything on me right now, but once I'm back in Sumeru, I'll be sure to send you something in return.
Now, I just need to make one for Candace so I can give it to her with the necklace. I'm sure she'll love it!
Ah, that reminds me, I wonder if she's here yet... It's been a while...

quests.description: Someone seems interested in creating a Gift Envelope…
